headline: US-Iran clashes reignite Hormuz risk premium, sending fuel futures surging
intro: Just when the market had settled into a quiet late-summer lull, the US and Iran traded strikes over the weekend and diesel/gasoline futures snapped back to attention — up 3% and counting. Add a Venezuela "mega-deal" nobody thinks will actually cut pump prices and a Goldman call for $63/bbl diesel margins, and refiners have plenty to chew on this week.
overview: Geopolitics is driving the tape: renewed US-Iran strikes and lingering Strait of Hormuz risk pushed RBOB and ULSD futures sharply higher, with Goldman noting Gulf oil exports still running at only two-thirds of pre-war levels. On the policy side, biodiesel/RFS small-refinery exemptions remain a flashpoint, with a producer coalition and soybean farmers warning of billions in lost demand, while Trump's touted Venezuela oil deal is being met with skepticism that it will move retail gas prices. Meanwhile Goldman Sachs sharply raised its 2027 diesel crack forecast on tightening global supply, and weekly data show crude stocks ticking up even as product markets stay tight.

stories.title: Fuel Futures Jump As Hormuz Risks Return To The Spotlight
stories.summary: Oil and diesel futures jumped roughly 3% after the US and Iran traded attacks over the weekend, ending a monthlong stalemate near the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: US, Iran Trade Strikes for First Time in a Month
stories.summary: US forces struck Iranian rocket launchers and Iran responded by firing missiles toward Jordan, marking the first direct exchange in a month.

stories.title: Goldman Says Gulf Oil Exports at 2/3 of Pre-War Level
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs estimates Persian Gulf oil exports have recovered to only about two-thirds of pre-war levels.

stories.title: Oil Price Supported by Renewed Geopolitical Risk
stories.summary: Oil prices remain supported by renewed geopolitical risk, with analysts citing supply-security uncertainty as the immediate bullish driver.

stories.title: Oil: geopolitical support and Venezuela deal risk – BNY
stories.summary: BNY strategists say oil is underpinned by US-Iran tensions near Hormuz plus Trump's claimed deal for US majority control over Venezuela's oil sector.

stories.title: The U.S. Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
stories.summary: NPR reports energy experts are skeptical the Trump administration's Venezuela oil deal will translate into lower gas prices for US drivers.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs Sees Diesel Refining Margins Soaring to $63 a Barrel
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs more than doubled its 2027 diesel refining-margin forecast to as high as $63/bbl, citing refinery outages and depleted fuel inventories.

stories.title: Front Month Nymex RBOB Gasoline Rose 4.24% This Week to Settle at $3.4899 — Data Talk
stories.summary: Front-month Nymex RBOB rose 4.24% on the week to settle at $3.4899/gal, its largest three-week gain since May.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Oil Prices Easing, on Track to End Week Lower -- OPIS
stories.summary: ULSD futures were on track to end the week lower despite a daily gain, per OPIS, settling nearly 14 cents below the prior week's close.

stories.title: USA Crude Oil Stocks Rise Slightly
stories.summary: EIA's latest weekly petroleum status report shows US crude stocks (ex-SPR) rose slightly to 428.9 million barrels as of August 21.

stories.title: Coalition sends letter to President Trump warning of consequences from increased SREs
stories.summary: A coalition warned Trump that expanded small-refinery exemptions could undercut the historic RFS volumes announced in March.

stories.title: Proposed refinery exemptions could cost soybean farmers $1B
stories.summary: The American Soybean Association says proposed small-refinery exemption changes under the RFS could cost soybean farmers $1 billion via reduced biodiesel demand.

stories.title: Indian Oil raises LPG output nearly 30% as Hormuz disruption tests energy security
stories.summary: Indian Oil raised LPG output nearly 30% and pushed refinery utilization to 109.4% as Hormuz disruptions test India's energy security.

stories.title: Colorado seeks more regulation of Suncor refinery to reduce harmful pollution
stories.summary: Colorado regulators are weighing tighter rules on Suncor's Commerce City refinery after flares were identified as the state's top VOC pollution source.
